title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if the OLS solution is unique, consider the concept of linear independence. If the columns of the design matrix are linearly independent, what does this imply about the matrix?

title: Full Rank Matrix
text: A matrix with linearly independent columns is said to be of full rank. What does this mean for the invertibility of the matrix?

title: Invertibility and Uniqueness
text: If a matrix is of full rank, it is invertible. How does this relate to the uniqueness of the OLS solution?

title: Matrix Invertibility
text: Given that the design matrix is of full rank, what can we say about its invertibility?

title: Unique OLS Solution
text: If the design matrix is invertible, what can we conclude about the OLS solution?
choices: The OLS solution is not unique.
